title: STK desktop bridge protocol v1
description: NDJSON messages between the STK desktop app and its Python bridge (python -m suan.desktop_bridge --stdio): requests, responses and events. $defs/methods/<name>/params|result and $defs/events/<name> describe each method and event. See docs/specs/stk-desktop-bridge-v1.md.

state.description: Local Runtime only: whether $STK_STATE_DIR holds a Runtime configuration (the local connection is always listed).

kind.description: request.kind, repeated at the top level by the bridge

blob.ensure.description: Make blobs available in the local cache (fetched from a hub connection when given).

colormaps.list.description: Built-in colormap LUTs (256 x RGBA8, base64) and palette names.

connections.add_runtime.description: Save a loopback Runtime endpoint and its token (inbound only); checks health unless check=false.

connections.check.description: Health of a connection; ok=false with an error when unreachable.

connections.list.description: Saved connections: the local Runtime, Runtime profiles and paired hubs (no credentials).

connections.local.description: Status of the Runtime initialized on this computer.

connections.local_start.description: Start the local Runtime API and supervisor (Linux server Runtime only).

initialize.description: Initialize the local Runtime ($STK_STATE_DIR) first when it has no configuration (default false)

connections.pair_hub.description: Claim a one-time client pairing code of a control hub; the device token stays in the bridge.

connections.remove.description: Forget a Runtime profile or a paired hub.

download.start.description: Download a task artifact or workspace input (resumable, journaled, sha256-verified).

idempotency_key.description: The same key returns the same transfer (also after a bridge restart); the same key with a different request is conflict

events.subscribe.description: Monitoring events (events.batch) from a byte offset; events.end once the task finished.

graph.cancel.description: Cancel an evaluation: a local one, or a hub one on its node (with connection and node also one this bridge is not waiting for).

graph.catalog.description: The node catalog stk.catalog/1 of this installation.

graph.evaluate.description: Evaluate a graph request locally or on a hub node; every referenced blob is in the local blob cache.

graph.presets.description: Shipped graph presets with their bindings and parameters.

graph.validate.description: Validate an stk.graph/1 document (issues with stable codes and JSON pointers).

hello.description: Negotiate the protocol; returns capabilities, limits and local cache paths. Send it first.

hub.action.description: One action with its full request and result; marks it inspected for review.

hub.actions.description: Recent actions and every action awaiting review (without results).

hub.devices.description: Devices of a hub: execution nodes with their latest snapshot (workspaces, tasks, features).

hub.policy.description: The hub's limits for this device: desktop auto-run cap, upload sizes, read kinds.

hub.review.description: Approve or reject an action in review; approving needs a prior hub.action (review_not_inspected).

hub.subscribe.description: Stream hub events (hub.event) from a cursor, reconnecting with backoff.

hub.templates.description: Command templates the hub runs without review.

logs.subscribe.description: Incremental UTF-8 log text (logs.chunk) from byte offsets on character boundaries; logs.end when done.

probe.description: Resolve where a picked layer's original data lives (suan.graph.probe) and sample it at position.

shutdown.description: Respond, then shut down gracefully (as on stdin EOF). Jobs keep running.

task.artifacts.description: Published files of a finished task with size and sha256 (empty while it runs).

task.get.description: One task record (with the monitoring summary when events exist).

task.list.description: Tasks, newest first, optionally of one workspace.

task.submit.description: Submit a TaskSpec (or a hub template); the same key returns the same task, a different spec is a conflict.

transfer.cancel.description: Stop a transfer; aborts the Runtime upload session or discards the partial download.

transfer.list.description: Every journaled transfer (finished ones are kept for 7 days).

transfer.resume.description: Continue an interrupted or failed transfer from its journal.

upload.start.description: Upload a file or a folder (resumable, journaled, sha256-verified): into a Runtime workspace, or through a hub into its blob store and then a reviewed workspace.import on the node.

remote.description: Relative destination (default: the source name). "." puts a folder's contents at the workspace root (a file keeps its name). Paths with "..", absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are invalid_params.

idempotency_key.description: The same key returns the same transfer (also after a bridge restart); the same key with a different request is conflict

watch.description: Task snapshots (watch.snapshot) every interval (2 s) when they change.

workspace.create.description: Create a workspace; the same idempotency_key returns the same workspace.

workspace.files.description: Input files of a workspace with size and sha256 (Runtime and hub connections).

workspace.list.description: Workspaces of a Runtime (or of a hub node's snapshot).

project.create.description: Create a local project directory/database; never replaces an existing database.

project.open.description: Open an existing local project and return a bridge-session handle.

project.list.description: List projects open in this bridge session.

project.close.description: Close a session handle without deleting the saved project.

project.snapshot.description: Read a consistent project snapshot by session handle.

project.apply.description: Apply an atomic edit batch at the expected revision. Never automatically retry after an uncertain response.

project.history.description: Read committed edit batches to inspect revisions and recover an uncertain edit response.

script.open.description: Open or return the one local Python console session. User code is never auto-run.

script.status.description: Read execution state; bridge/project lifetimes are independent of the disposable worker.

script.execute.description: Execute explicit source or a UTF-8 file in the persistent worker. Never automatically replay.

script.read.description: Read bounded console output; cursors count Unicode characters, not bytes. Reading acknowledges change hints.

script.interrupt.description: Stop the worker and reset its namespace (also valid when idle). Accepted operations are not rolled back.

script.close.description: Close the local Python session and stop its subprocess tree. Project handles stay open.

script.catalog.description: Discover currently scriptable bridge operations and local UI control names.

ui.attach.description: Attach the local desktop executor; only operations advertised by it can be called.

ui.detach.description: Detach an executor; unblock pending reverse requests with unavailable.

ui.reply.description: Reply to a ui.request. Unknown, expired, duplicate or detached requests return accepted=false.

connections.ssh.description: Inspect, connect or explicitly disconnect a managed OpenSSH Runtime tunnel. Never starts or cancels Runtime jobs.

project.backup.description: Create a consistent database backup under the project backups directory. External assets are separate; project revision is unchanged.

project.upgrade.description: Explicitly upgrade an older project after a verified database backup, using a revision precondition. Opening never migrates.

project.undo.description: Undo a persistent edit batch as a new revision. Format 3 is required. Never replay automatically.

project.redo.description: Redo a persistent edit batch as a new revision. Format 3 is required. Never replay automatically.

project.files.index.description: Explicit metadata-only file index as a shared undoable edit batch. No file contents are changed.

project.files.refresh.description: Explicit metadata-only file refresh as a shared undoable edit batch. No file contents are changed.

project.files.resolve.description: Check a saved file location at an explicit revision and return the current absolute path. Does not launch an application.

project.files.list.description: Read saved file observations; does not scan the filesystem.

task.logs.description: Read one bounded log chunk as base64 bytes. Offsets count bytes; terminal describes task state, not end of this chunk. No subscription is created.

project.snapshots.list.description: List immutable input manifests without reading object contents.

project.snapshots.get.description: Read a stored input manifest and validate its identity/checksum.

project.snapshots.capture.description: Explicitly copy selected indexed files into verified content-addressed storage and append an immutable manifest; requires format 4.

project.snapshots.verify.description: Hash all frozen input objects and report missing or changed content; no repairs or writes.

project.snapshots.resolve.description: Verify and return one frozen input object path; does not consult the current source file.

project.runs.prepare.description: Freeze 1–100 parameter rows, input bindings and explicit TaskSpecs without contacting a Runtime; requires format 5.

project.runs.list.description: Read paginated compact run summaries and current parameter freshness, without contacting a Runtime.

project.runs.get.description: Read a frozen plan and latest persisted observation.

project.runs.submit.description: Explicitly submit or recover this immutable attempt using its persistent idempotency key; no automatic retry.

project.runs.refresh.description: Read remote task/action status; never submit a prepared or uncertain run.

project.runs.cancel.description: Explicitly cancel an accepted task; preserves Hub review policy.

project.recent.description: Read up to 20 saved recent project locations without opening their databases. Names and timestamps are historical metadata. Persistence errors are reported as warning.

project.forget.description: Forget a recent location without closing sessions or deleting project files.

project.csv.import.description: Import a UTF-8 CSV/TSV as a new typed table in one atomic edit batch; unspecified columns are text.

project.csv.export.description: Export evaluated table values at an explicit revision to a new CSV/TSV file without overwriting; does not change the project.

project.preview.description: Preview the same edit commands on an in-memory database copy (128 MiB source limit), with no persisted edits or events. Apply returned commands explicitly at base_revision.

project.drafts.save.description: Save a validated immutable project proposal (format 6) without applying edits or changing revision/history. Reusing an ID with the same original request recovers the saved draft.

project.drafts.get.description: Read a saved proposal and its durable application/discard status.

project.drafts.list.description: Read paginated saved-draft summaries, including closed drafts, without full commands.

project.drafts.apply.description: Explicitly apply a saved pending draft atomically at its original revision, recording its receipt. Applied drafts return a replay receipt without applying again, including after ordinary undo.

project.drafts.discard.description: Close a pending draft without modifying project tables, revision or history.

project.contexts.capture.description: Capture immutable explicitly selected project cells at one revision (format 7), without evaluating dependencies, editing tables or publishing change events. Keep the caller UUID to recover an identical request.

project.contexts.get.description: Read one frozen context, including value omissions and missing-object diagnostics.

project.contexts.list.description: Read saved context summaries without captured values; no automatic refresh or recapture.

project.discussion.add.description: Save explicit nonblank UTF-8 text (at most 64 KiB) bound to a captured context. Role and text are metadata and cannot execute operations.

project.discussion.get.description: Read a saved plain-text message and its context identity.

project.discussion.list.description: Read message summaries without full text.

project.discussion.link_draft.description: Associate a saved draft with a message and matching context revision. This is provenance only and neither applies nor approves the draft.

project.discussion.proposals.description: Read immutable message/context/draft provenance, optionally filtered by exact draft ID.

project.requests.create.description: Save immutable model-request intent (format 8) for a saved user message and its context. No adapter is invoked; keep the caller UUID for retries.

project.requests.get.description: Read saved request identity and observations. Never start or replay generation.

project.requests.list.description: Read paged request metadata without message text or captured cells.

project.requests.cancel.description: Record cancellation intent. Pending requests become cancelled; running requests become uncertain until an executor can prove their outcome. Never send or retry.

bytes.description: next_offset - offset: the bytes of the events file this batch covers
next_offset - offset: the source bytes this message covers (text may differ in length where invalid UTF-8 became U+FFFD)

definitions.description: Field UUID to stable reference/expression definition; absent for literal-only records.

evaluations.description: Field UUID to state, value/unit or structured error, evaluated_revision and engine_version.
